# LivingDex.app

> A fast, modern, privacy-first Living Pokédex tracker for all main-series Pokémon games, including regional forms, DLC expansions, and shiny checklists.

## Overview

LivingDex.app is a client-side Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed to track Pokémon Living Dex progress with zero dependencies, zero tracking, and instant local persistence via localStorage.

- **Website**: https://livingdex.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/PimBARF/LivingDex
- **License**: MIT
- **Data Sources**: PokéAPI, Bulbapedia, Serebii

## Core Features

- **Multi-Game Support**: Tracks living dexes across Generations 1 through 9, including Pokémon HOME, Scarlet & Violet (with The Teal Mask & The Indigo Disk), Sword & Shield (with Isle of Armor & Crown Tundra), and Legends: Arceus / Z-A.
- **Form & Expansion Tracking**: Dedicated sections for regional forms (Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian, Paldean), Gigantamax forms, and DLC expansions.
- **In-Game Encounter Details**: Interactive info modals providing exact wild locations, raid dens, and trade notes per game release.
- **Evolution Flowcharts**: Visual branch-aware evolution trees respecting game generation scope and item requirements.
- **Shareable Progress**: URL hash-encoded checklist state allows sharing caught progress via simple links without requiring a database backend.
- **Offline First**: Fully functional offline via Service Worker caching with custom sprite caching.

## URL Parameters & Routing

- `?game={gameId}`: Load a specific game tracker.
  - `home`: Pokémon HOME (National Pokédex #1–1025)
  - `sv`: Pokémon Scarlet & Violet
  - `swsh`: Pokémon Sword & Shield
  - `pla`: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
  - `za`: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
  - `bdsp`: Pokémon Brilliant Diamond & Shining Pearl
  - `lgpe`: Pokémon Let's Go Pikachu & Eevee
  - `usum`: Pokémon Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon
  - `sm`: Pokémon Sun & Moon
  - `oras`: Pokémon Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire
  - `xy`: Pokémon X & Y
  - `b2w2`: Pokémon Black 2 & White 2
  - `bw`: Pokémon Black & White
  - `hgss`: Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver
  - `dppt`: Pokémon Diamond, Pearl & Platinum
  - `frlg`: Pokémon FireRed & LeafGreen
  - `rse`: Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald
  - `gsc`: Pokémon Gold, Silver & Crystal
  - `rby`: Pokémon Red, Blue & Yellow
- `#s={hash}`: Encoded compressed bitfield of caught slot indices.

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, Modern CSS (CSS Grid, Custom Properties, container queries, `content-visibility: auto`), ES Modules.
- **Storage**: LocalStorage (`{gamePrefix}-caught-v1`, `{gamePrefix}-shiny-caught-v1`, `settings-v1`).
- **Compression**: pako Deflate/Inflate for URL hash serialization.
